fusions.name: Final Syllable
fusions.desc: A spoken bolt that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Two-Word Command
fusions.desc: Looses 2 bolts of arcane force at once, spread apart out to 6 tiles, each dealing 7 damage. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Drilled Cadence
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds. A packmate fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Learned by Rote
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner.
